name: W Bangkok
positioning: A Sathorn hotel in two parts, a sleek 31-story glass tower and The House on Sathorn, an 1889 neo-classical landmark, near the BTS SkyTrain
best_for: City travelers who want a design-forward tower stay near the BTS SkyTrain
Guests drawn to history who want to explore a restored 1889 mansion on site

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Sathorn.
The hotel is near the BTS SkyTrain's Chong Nonsi Station.
Paii serves modern Thai seafood at The House on Sathorn.
Bar Sathorn serves cocktails inspired by the historic mansion, blending Thai culture and local ingredients.
The outdoor WET pool on the sixth floor is surrounded by lounge chairs, couches and covered day beds.
Rooms and suites have touchscreen lighting controls to set the mood.
The hotel grows organic vegetables on its rooftop using compost from its kitchens.
The House on Sathorn Heritage Tour explores the building's history.
The Presidential Suite is a top-floor corner suite with a whirlpool.

highlights.text: The House on Sathorn is a preserved neo-classical landmark from 1889 that has been a private residence, a hotel and the Russian Embassy.
The hotel has two parts: the century-old House on Sathorn and a sleek 31-story glass tower.
The pool has in-pool LED lights in bold hues and underwater music.
AWAY Spa on the sixth floor has four zones.
The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange a banquet cruising the Chao Phraya River or a helicopter ride over temples and skyscrapers.

considerations.text: The pool and fitness center are reserved for in-house guests.
One pet up to 18 kg is allowed per room.
WhataHotel notes the modern lifestyle style may not suit traditional luxury preferences.
